fields.acceptance: A Go test (Linux) starts a Setsid child that nothing waits on, lets it exit, runs the reaper, and finds the pid gone with no zombie left, while a plain os/exec child running at the same time still gets its own exit status from Wait; the reaper runs at daemon start and on each tick, and does nothing off Linux
fields.statement: The daemon reaps its finished run drivers, including those started by an image before a re-exec, so none stays a zombie: at start and on a timer it waits by pid, without blocking, on each child of its own that leads its own session, and never on the git, make or hook children os/exec waits on
